title: Taiwanese Student Association at the University of Southern California
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association (TSA) at the University of Southern California is a registered student organization focused on showcasing Taiwanese culture on campus. The organization is listed in USC’s official EngageSC club directory and maintains an active Instagram presence under @usc_tsa as well as a Facebook page and a dedicated Wix website. Its founding year is not documented in available first-party sources.

The TSA’s stated purpose is to showcase Taiwanese culture at USC, organize events, and bring together the Taiwanese community at the university. The organization aims to spread Taiwanese culture and traditions both to students from Taiwan and to anyone at USC with an interest in Taiwan, hosting semester events for members to connect with one another. Its focus is primarily on students from Taiwan studying at USC, distinguishing it from the separately constituted Taiwanese American Organization (TAO) on the same campus.
